units.source_text: 第二次行为是在已经熟悉的环境中，毫不迟误地轻松而安乐地进行的。

en.t: The second act was carried out lightly and comfortably, without the slightest delay, in surroundings that had already become familiar.

units.source_text: 这回，我似乎也瞥见了快乐，

en.t: This time, I seemed to catch a glimpse of pleasure as well,

units.source_text: 但那不是想像一类的快乐，

en.t: but it was not the kind of pleasure born of imagination,

units.source_text: 而只不过是自觉适应了这种情事的一种自我堕落的满足罢了。

en.t: it was merely the self-degraded satisfaction of knowing that I had adapted myself to this sort of affair.
